Exampleton: a synthetic town for examples and tests

Source: R/exampleton.R
exampleton.Rd

Exampleton is a made-up town of about 1,500 parcels, built by the script in data-raw/exampleton.R so that every rule type plancap handles has something to act on. It is placed in the sea about 250 km east of New Zealand's North Island, in New Zealand Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2193), so it cannot be mistaken for a real place.

Usage

exampleton()

exampleton_layer(layer)

exampleton_layers()

Arguments

layer

Name of one layer. See exampleton_layers().

Value

exampleton() returns a named list of sf data frames, one per layer. exampleton_layer() returns one sf data frame.

Details

What it contains, and what each part is there to exercise:

LayerGeometryExercises
parcelspolygonLand lots, road parcels and reserves in one layer, as a national cadastre supplies them (parcel_type). Corner lots, rear (battle-axe) lots with access legs, through lots, a large amalgamated site, and lots that share a title_id
road_centrelineslineStreet names and road reserve widths (width_m); Main Street is wider
zoningpolygonSeven zones (zone); one block is split between two zones, so some lots straddle a zone boundary
height_areaspolygonMapped height limits (max_height_m) over the centre and its frame
flood_hazardpolygonAn exclusion along the river
heritagepolygonA flag-only overlay on a few centre lots
precinctspolygonOne precinct with two sub-precincts (sub_precinct)
waterlineA river through the southern reserve, for riparian setbacks
transitpointA station, for distance-band rules
treespointTrees with trunk diameter (dbh_m), status ("protected" or "unprotected") and a root-zone protection_radius_m
buildingspolygonExisting buildings with storeys, for net-of-existing capacity

A ground surface is supplied separately as a 5 m raster; see exampleton_dem().

See also

exampleton_dem(), exampleton_path()

Examples

town <- exampleton()
names(town)
#>  [1] "parcels"          "road_centrelines" "zoning"           "height_areas"    
#>  [5] "flood_hazard"     "heritage"         "precincts"        "water"           
#>  [9] "transit"          "trees"            "buildings"       
table(town$parcels$parcel_type)
#> 
#>    land reserve    road 
#>    1377       2      88 

zones <- exampleton_layer("zoning")
zones$zone
#> [1] "TC"  "MU"  "HDR" "MDR" "LDR" "IND" "OS"
